name: Cafe 18
why_it_matters: Opened 8 May 2019 by Anirudh Ubhan opposite the District Court — Uttarkashi's first proper modern cafe and consistently the highest-rated restaurant in town (4.8 on Restaurant Guru, 4.5 on Google over 300+ reviews). The room locals send returning Gangotri trekkers to.
insider_tip: Closed 3-4pm daily and Sundays mornings — they reopen at 4pm. Order the pizza if you want what made the place; the momos are a holdover from the pre-cafe Uttarkashi palate.
signature_address: Opposite District Court, Court Road, Uttarkashi 249193

name: Cafe TFH (The Food Habit)
why_it_matters: Run by mountaineer-photographer Tilak Soni near Axis Bank on the highway. The only place in Uttarkashi that serves authentic South Indian food — and the cosy library nook is a deliberate detour for trekkers waiting out a weather day.
insider_tip: Ask for the book corner upstairs — Soni's curated shelf of mountaineering and Garhwal titles is the under-advertised draw. South Indian breakfast is best before 11am while the chutneys are fresh.
signature_address: Near Axis Bank, Gangotri Highway, Uttarkashi 249193

name: Pahadibucks Cafe
why_it_matters: Launched in 2018 as a homestay-cafe combo 6km out of town toward Gangotri, with private Bhagirathi-river access in non-monsoon months. The cafe deck looks straight onto the river — currently the highest-rated dining experience in the Uttarkashi entry on TripAdvisor (5.0).
insider_tip: Open river-side seating only works October-May; monsoon (July-September) the river is too high. They source vegetables from their own kitchen garden — ask what's local that day.
signature_address: Near Ganeshpur Petrol Pump, Harshil-Gangotri Road, Uttarkashi 249193

name: Steamer
why_it_matters: Run by Manoj in Gyansu, 2km from Uttarkashi centre — the consensus best Chinese in the district per local Wanderlog and Restaurant Guru rankings. Steamed (not fried) momos are the discipline; the kitchen never deep-fries the headline dish.
insider_tip: Mutton momos are made fresh on order — call ahead (+91 81268 26263) if you want them; otherwise the chicken ones come out in 8 minutes flat. Kitchen closes 10pm, last orders 9:30.

name: Anushka Restaurant
why_it_matters: Family-run, owner-and-son operation near Kandar Devta Mandir serving a single fixed thali — sabji, roti, dal, chawal, rajma, kadi — for ₹90. The simplest honest meal in town; ranked #7 of Uttarkashi's 19 main eateries on Wanderlog.
insider_tip: There is no menu — only the thali, served 11am-10pm. Best after 7:30pm when the second batch of dal and rajma is fresh. Cash only.
signature_address: Rana Bhawan, near Kandar Devta Mandir, Uttarkashi 249193

name: Annapurna Restaurant
why_it_matters: One of the few places in Main Bazaar that serves actual Garhwali home cooking — phaanu (mixed-dal curry), chainsoo (roasted black-gram), kumaoni raita — alongside fast food for the bus-stand crowd. The local-cuisine menu is unadvertised; ask for the Pahadi thali.
insider_tip: Phaanu and chainsoo are slow-cooked — they only run them at lunch, finished by 2pm. The fast-food menu (momos, pasta) goes till close but skips the reason to come.

name: GMVN Tourist Rest House Restaurant
why_it_matters: The state-run Garhwal Mandal Vikas Nigam rest house — primarily for Char Dham yatris — has a public-facing pure-veg restaurant near the Collector Office, half a km from the bus stand. Predictable, hygienic, government-rate pricing; the default safe meal between Char Dham legs.
insider_tip: Open to non-residents at all three meals; lunch (12-3pm) is the strongest sitting because the kitchen cooks for the in-house yatri groups. No alcohol, strictly vegetarian.
signature_address: GMVN Tourist Rest House, Tiloth Road, near Collector Office, Uttarkashi 249193

name: Monal Tourist Home Restaurant
why_it_matters: Listed in Lonely Planet, Rough Guide, Let's Go and Outlook as the place to stay in Uttarkashi since 1993. The glass-walled dining room overlooks the Bhagirathi — owner-cooked menu, no fixed card; you eat what the kitchen made that day. Free shelf of mountaineering books on the side wall.
insider_tip: Walk-ins allowed for meals if there's space — call first (01374 222270) so they can scale the dal. Trekkers with early Gangotri starts are served breakfast from 6am if pre-arranged.
signature_address: Kot Bungalow Road, near DFO Office, Uttarkashi 249193
